{{Compendium/Extract|Grizzlemaw Bear}}
Grizzlemaw Bears are a rare and strong type of [[Bear]]. They are a breed of [[Honeyvore Bear]], though they are physically distinguished by their darker fur and gray muzzles.<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|This breed of honeyvore bear is distinguished by its gray fur. Even more ferocious than their relatives, they're commonly believed to be the most dangerous wild animal. They live in deep snow away from villages, so it's uncommon to encounter one. That said, if you do find one, you'd be better off not picking a fight with it.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> They are highly aggressive and territorial animals, and as a result, they are considered to the most dangerous wild animals native to [[Hyrule]] during the [[Era of the Wilds]].<ref name="Compendium"/> Most commonly, Grizzlemaw Bears live in [[Freezing Climate]]s away from civilization, such as the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Gerudo Highlands]].<ref name="Compendium"/> If a Grizzlemaw Bear spots [[Link]], it will attack him.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 163}}</ref> When killed, Grizzlemaw Bears drop [[Raw Prime Meat]]s, [[Raw Gourmet Meat]]s, and [[Hearty Salmon]]s.

Grizzlemaw Bears are one of a few Creatures that can be ridden and tamed by Link. However, if he takes it to a [[Stable]], the owner will refuse to register it, since it is not a [[Horse]].<ref>{{Cite|Not a problem. Let me just— Oh, for the love of Hylia... That's not a horse! We only board horses here, stranger. No exceptions.|Tasseren|BotW}}</ref>

==Trivia==
* Grizzlemaw Bears are one of nine rideable [[Creature]]s in {{BotW|-}}. The other eight are the [[Horse]], the [[Giant Horse]], the [[White Horse]], the [[Lord of the Mountain]], the [[Mountain Buck]], the [[Mountain Doe]], the [[Stalhorse]], and the [[Honeyvore Bear]].
** Of these mounts, the Grizzlemaw Bear is is one of six that cannot be registered at a Stable.
